Local Linux environment (proot Ubuntu) now boots again, so the AGY Hub starts on port 1237 and chats/MCP servers load
Includes 1.0.17 hub hardening: background hub start, crash auto-restart with backoff, CSRF refresh/retry and bridge auto-restart
